direction.grid: 100vw x 100dvh, overflow hidden at 1366x768; rows 48px header / 40px compact horizontal rail / minmax(0,1fr) main / 56px action bar; compact horizontal rail only; independent reserved zones for scene, callouts, stations and jobs with no overlap; rendered scene fills at least 70% of main; side content condensed inside its reserved zone; all targets at least 36px, rail targets equal width, non-wrapping, aria-current and arrow-key movement
direction.colorTokens: Entirely black, emerald green and brushed silver: bg #050705, panel #0B100B, raised #121A12, border rgba(197,204,212,.22); brushed silver #C5CCD4 headings and machine bodies, dim silver rgba(197,204,212,.68) secondary text; emerald/neon #A8F04A sole accent and primary fill with #050705 text, one primary per viewport; stopped states use silver cross-hatching, x cross marker and plain OFFLINE text, never red; official logo immutable in black, emerald/neon green and brushed silver at native aspect in exactly two placements: header and opening story
direction.typography: System sans; 16px/24 body minimum, no label under 12px; header tabs span most of the header with labels at least 16px; 24/30 stage title, 18/24 panel title, 12/16 uppercase micro-labels, 26px tabular metrics; one verb-led instruction and one status sentence per step; minimal narration
direction.motion: Living material flow, state glow, depth and cinematic transitions driven by real state; 160-220ms ease-out for selection and panels, one 240ms route trace on state change; prefers-reduced-motion removes transitions and flow while silver pattern, cross marker and OFFLINE text retain meaning; 2px emerald focus ring with 2px offset; pointer style only on enabled controls
direction.components: Header 48px with official logo left, large tabs spanning most of the header, Lock recovery room right; opening story carries the second required logo placement; compact horizontal rail from one steps array; focusable cinematic factory SVG as dominant scene; side zone keeps connection readiness checks for provider identity separate from the investigation evidence task under separate headings, status and controls; action bar 56px with Back left, status centre and one primary right; selecting a recovery option opens one-click Approve then the Authorize this decision wall; pending task proposals deliberately untracked until human approval; blocked prior tasks and an approved recovery plan can coexist while replacement tasks await approval; tab order skip-to-stage, header, rail, SVG nodes, side zone, action bar; Enter/Space activate, Esc closes, aria-live polite for results
direction.visualizations: State-driven 960x540 cinematic factory SVG enlarged to fill at least 70% of main using real state only: MAT-ALLOY-A held, 40+30=70 units, feasible routes only in emerald, silver idle machines, stopped CELL-MILL-2 in silver cross-hatching with x marker and plain OFFLINE text and no route through it; aligned Certificate 120 versus Receiving 80 tracks with DOES NOT MATCH spanning the gap inside stage bounds; bidirectional SVG-to-side-zone highlighting; persistent Running/Held/Blocked/Offline/Feasible-Accepted legend with pattern, marker and text; animated flow along feasible routes with reduced-motion static alternative

Give each Select this path control at least 36px height, clear selected state beyond colour, and arrow-key friendly grouping.
Keep the three proposed tasks explicitly PROPOSED and UNTRACKED UNTIL APPROVAL, with Approve as the single primary action.

Strengthen the living emerald mills to lathes cascade with depth and machine glow, and keep routes only through feasible running machines.
